description: Monitoraggi ARPA: Radiazioni non ionizzanti - Misure del campo elettrico a radiofrequenza is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by servizisct.regione.vda.it. The indicator quantifies the activity carried out by the Agency in carrying out checks to verify the radio frequency electromagnetic field values generated by broadcasting or mobile telephony installations. Measurements can be instantaneous or short-lived (a few days). Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "ARPA monitoring: Non-ionizing radiation - Measurements of the radiofrequency electric field" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include open data. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
